title: Live Attack Surface, Dead Fossils, and Zombie Activation: Multi-Edge Reachability and Linker-Hygiene Auditing of Stripped Android Vendor Binaries
description: Follow-up research paper (Part II of 'The Borrow Checker as a Binary Auditor', DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24261883) and companion #![forbid(unsafe_code)] Safe Rust crate (s9_blur_detection, verified across 30,118 SplitMix64 and boundary FFI vectors with 0 ULP divergence and 1.18x-2.66x speedup). Introduces Stage 1.5 Multi-Edge Reachability and Linker-Hygiene Auditing across 53 AArch64 ELF binaries from Android 10 (SM-G960U) to Android 16 (SM-S938B and SM-S948B), classifying 20 C/C++ defects into Class I (Live Wired), Class II (Intra-Binary Dead Fossils), and Class III (Cross-Generation Zombie Activation), and quantifying pervasive -fvisibility=hidden omissions.
